absences: New buyer deals dated 2026-11-20 to 2026-11-24 (PPA, LOI, MOU, contract, site selection): searched across Radiant, Antares, Aalo, Valar, Deployable Energy, Westinghouse eVinci, Oklo, NANO Nuclear, Deep Fission, Last Energy, Idaho Falls Power and Army/Air Force host-site news. None found; no items filed.

Eielson NOITA date unresolved: shipped row says announced 2025-06-11. Search summaries give June 2025, May 2026 and an August 31 DAF milestone; eielson.af.mil and af.mil returned HTTP 403 to WebFetch. No check written.
Oklo-Switch: no 2026 update found. Oklo Q3 2026 results (released 2026-11-06, per search summary) did not disclose LOI-to-PPA conversions for Switch. Shipped row left unchanged.
NANO-Supermicro MOU (shipped as May 2026): date and non-binding status come from a search summary citing NANO's release dated 2026-05-06. Primary release not fetched; no check written.

Equinix-Radiant: no site named in any 2026 source found. WNN 2025-08-15 (fetched) confirms preorder for 20 Kaleidos and a separate Letter of Intent with ULC-Energy for up to 250 MWe; that LOI is outside the window and not shipped.

Aalo-Crusoe commercial partnership (Powermag, fetched, dated 2026-07-30): Aalo to power a Crusoe Spark at INL in 2027 and deploy Aalo Pods and 50 MWe XMR plants at Crusoe data centers by end-2029, described as a plan. Outside the window and not shipped. DCD source returned HTTP 403.
Aalo and Idaho Falls Power: the 2024 MOU for seven Aalo-1 reactors is the latest found; the PPA is still described as under negotiation. No signed PPA found.
Last Energy: 2023 PPAs for 10 units at KSSE (Poland) and 24 UK units, binding status undisclosed (Powermag, fetched, 2023-03-23). Outside the window and not mentioned in the uk-lastenergy row.
Not searched per skip list: Army Janus sites, ANPI Malmstrom, DOE Reactor Pilot, Canada SRC, Texas backup, Romania NuScale.

checks.claim: Target online 2030; ONR's June 2025 preliminary review covered the PWR-20 design, not any site; Last Energy's planned site licence is for Llynfi, Wales
checks.evidence: ONR PDR summary report (fetched; page dated 'Updated: 3 February 2026' is the web page date, not the review date). The PDR was completed in June 2025. The report says the PDR 'enabled the regulators to examine and discuss aspects of the PWR-20 design', and refers to a 'prospective nuclear site licence application related to the Llynfi site'. The 2030 online target is not stated on this page and was not checked here.
